name: overwatch
summary: Hold a shot or a zone under fire until the shooter's next turn, and say which foes draw a strike.

maneuver.description: An overwatch maneuver in ruleset/data/maneuvers/core.json: pinning_fire (a zone) or trigger_watch (a held shot).

perks.description: The shooter's held perks at their ranks; given, one must unlock the maneuver at the rank held (unlocks_at_rank).

maneuvers.description: Maneuvers keys a monster's sheet lists, which it makes with no perk.

weapon_properties.description: The ranged weapon's properties; the maneuver's without_weapon_properties refuse it.

loadout.description: What the shooter holds: the attack's AP is the loadout's (attack_sequences/core.json), the attack action's without it. Two hand guns may lay Pinning Fire though they load.

ap.description: Pinning Fire: the AP left, all spent. Trigger Watch: the held AP the attack's AP is reserved from.

rounds.description: Rounds carried; the maneuver's rounds come off it. Left out, rounds are not counted.

foe.description: Which foe, an index the caller keeps.

in_zone.description: Pinning Fire: the move ends in the zone or crosses it, or the attack is made from it. Default false.

in_range.description: Trigger Watch: the foe is in the weapon's range. Default false.

events.description: What the table saw until the shooter's next turn, in order.

ap_returned.description: Trigger Watch: the reserved AP back to the pool when no foe drew the shot.

rounds.description: Rounds spent: Pinning Fire's three, Trigger Watch's one when it fires.

attack.description: The add on the strike's attack roll, for the caller's combat command.

shots.description: The strikes the events drew, in order, for the caller to resolve with combat.

attack.description: The add on that foe's own attack.

zone_attacks.description: Pinning Fire: the attacks foes made from the zone, at its penalty.
